units: thousands of housing units; construction cost in millions of dollars; average cost per unit in dollars; prices in dollars

field_notes.hs_location_a_k/hs_location_b_k: 1889-1944: urban / rural nonfarm areas; 1959-1970: inside / outside SMSAs; absent 1945-1958
field_notes.hs_total_k: HS series N156; 1889-1958 excludes farm housing, 1959-1970 as published includes farm housing (excluding-farm totals for 1959-62: 1531, 1274, 1337, 1469). 1945-1958 has no structure-type split.
field_notes.hs_avg_cost_per_unit: N167; permit valuations adjusted for understatement, privately-owned units pre-1963 are estimates
field_notes.nrc_*: privately owned units; NRC totals start 1959, completions 1968; 2to4 and 5plus NA before 1968 starts_cust
field_notes.starts_best_k: HS total through 1958, NRC private total from 1959

series_breaks: 1889-1919 Blank (NBER); 1920-1929 Wickens-Foster (NBER); 1930-1944 BLS/Wickens-Foster revision; 1945-1958 BLS revisions by Census; 1959+ Census permit-based estimates (HS text).
Permit-issuing universe: 6,600 places before 1959; 10,000 from 1959; 12,000 1963-67; 13,000 from 1967 (HS text).
HS excludes mobile homes, conversions, temporary units; units in nonresidential structures.
1959-1970 HS includes public units; NRC series are private only.
